name: 5 V single-channel relay module
summary: Switches a load from a 5 V active-low input. Contacts are rated 10 A at 250 VAC.

faq.a: 10 A at 250 VAC. That rating is the load, not the logic pin.
The relay module in an antistatic bag.

faq.q: What voltage does the logic pin accept?
faq.a: This page does not say. The listing gives the coil voltage, not the logic-pin voltage.

in_the_bag: Relay module in an antistatic bag.
limits: The coil supply is 5 V. The contact rating is the load, not the logic pin.
description: Single-channel module with an SRD-05VDC-SL-C relay. 5 V coil, opto-isolator, active-low trigger, indicator LED, and a flyback diode. Contacts are rated 10 A at 250 VAC. Sourced from Hall Road, Lahore.
